identificationModule.briefTitle: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) of Appendicitis in Children
identificationModule.officialTitle: Magnetic Resonance Evaluation of Appendicitis in Children Aged 8-18

responsibleParty.investigatorTitle: Assistant Professor of Radiology and Pediatrics

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Study to find out if MRI can diagnose appendicitis in children as well as or better than CT scan and/or ultrasound scan performed at the same time. No additional contrast material or sedation will be used to perform the MRI.

armGroups.label: Only one arm
armGroups.description: All patients enrolled will receive an MRI of the abdomen with detailed views of the appendix

interventions.name: MRI of the abdomen
interventions.description: Multiple MRI pulse sequences of the abdomen

primaryOutcomes.measure: Diagnostic Sensitivity/Specificity and Accuracy of Appendiceal MRI Comparedsurgical Findings or Clinical Follow-up
primaryOutcomes.description: Sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV)

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 8-18 years, referred from emergency department for suspected appendicitis and receiving either CT scan or ultrasound of the abdomen for diagnosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Failure to pass MRI metal screening. Claustrophobia or need for sedation due to inability to hold still.

references.citation: Hormann M, Paya K, Eibenberger K, Dorffner R, Lang S, Kreuzer S, Metz VM. MR imaging in children with nonperforated acute appendicitis: value of unenhanced MR imaging in sonographically selected cases. AJR Am J Roentgenol. 1998 Aug;171(2):467-70. doi: 10.2214/ajr.171.2.9694477.
Hormann M, Puig S, Prokesch SR, Partik B, Helbich TH. MR imaging of the normal appendix in children. Eur Radiol. 2002 Sep;12(9):2313-6. doi: 10.1007/s00330-002-1351-0. Epub 2002 May 9.
Pedrosa I, Levine D, Eyvazzadeh AD, Siewert B, Ngo L, Rofsky NM. MR imaging evaluation of acute appendicitis in pregnancy. Radiology. 2006 Mar;238(3):891-9. doi: 10.1148/radiol.2383050146.
Incesu L, Coskun A, Selcuk MB, Akan H, Sozubir S, Bernay F. Acute appendicitis: MR imaging and sonographic correlation. AJR Am J Roentgenol. 1997 Mar;168(3):669-74. doi: 10.2214/ajr.168.3.9057512.
